title: IVF myth flip — 'just relax' (Nadia, 36, cycle 3)
caption:
Myth: "just relax and it'll happen." In BMJ 2011, distress before an IVF cycle didn't predict pregnancy. Ask your clinic for FertiQoL by name (ESHRE).
Which myth should we flip next? 👇
www.aiforheratx.org
#ivf #fertility #ivfsupport #infertilityawareness #womensmentalhealth #ttc

scenes.text: Everyone keeps telling me to *relax*. Stress is not what's stopping this.

phrases: Me, on the bathroom floor with a sharps bin: I am not fine.

scenes.text: She's circled every shot day on the fridge. Somewhere in there she started *blaming* herself.
phrases: Cycle two failed on a Tuesday.
Then she blamed herself for googling at 2am.

scenes.text: A friend sent her the study. Distress before a cycle did *not* predict who got pregnant.
phrases: How stressed she was going in...
...didn't predict the outcome. It was never her fault.

scenes.text: Ask for *FertiQoL* by name, ask who the clinic's counsellor is, and walk twenty minutes today.
phrases: Say the word FertiQoL out loud at your next appointment.
Ask who the counsellor is. Your clinic is meant to have one.
Walk 20 minutes today — WHO asks for 150 a week, split however.
